product.title: Norix Ironman Citadel Property Storage Box Lid – PBL201-607.1
product.body_html:
The Norix Ironman Citadel Property Storage Box Lid fits the Norix Citadel PB301 property storage box and closes it off for secure storage. It has a hasp for locking and a locating feature that keeps stacked boxes lined up, so property stays organized whether the boxes are kept in cells or in a property room.

The lid is injection molded from the same high impact polypropylene copolymer as the box, and it is made in the USA. The box is sold separately.

  • Material: Injection-molded high impact polypropylene copolymer, 100% recyclable
  • Locking: Hasp for locking
  • Stacking: Locating feature for stacking boxes
  • Dimensions: 26” W × 18.2” D × 2” H
  • Weight: 4 lbs
  • Fits: Norix Citadel PB301-607.1 property storage box
  • Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletin 133, UL 1056, ASTM E1537, and NFPA 261
  • Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
  • Color: Raven (black)
  • Box: Sold separately as the Norix Citadel Property Storage Box
  • Made In: USA
  • Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
  • Intended Use: Indoor use only

No assembly is required.

Applications

Adding a lid lets facilities lock Citadel boxes and stack them neatly. For Tank Boxes, use the matching Norix Tank Box lids instead.

Typical applications include:

  • Prisons, jails, and detention centers
  • Allowable in-cell property storage
  • Inmate records and personal property storage

Explore Anchortex's Prison & Detention Inmate Property Storage Solutions collection for more property boxes, garment bags, and storage lockers.

About Norix Ironman Detention Series

The Norix Ironman Detention Series includes heavy-duty correctional furniture, fixtures, and equipment designed for prisons, jails, detention centers, and other secure environments. Ironman products emphasize durability, security-conscious design, and low-maintenance construction for demanding institutional use.

The Ironman Series includes:

  • Steel Bunks: Floor-mounted single and double bunks and wall-mounted bunks
  • Seating: Benches with cuff rings for intake and holding areas and floor-mount stools
  • Washroom Accessories: Stainless steel ADA shower seats, grab bars, toilet paper holders, and hooks
  • Property Storage: Tank Box and Citadel inmate property storage boxes with matching lids

About Norix Furniture

Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.
